Article: Set up and manage online appointment booking for patients
Enable patients to schedule routine visits directly through the web and mobile portal by configuring your scheduling rules. Only providers with active schedules and visit types marked as 'Online Eligible' will appear to patients.

1. Go to **Settings > Patient Portal > Booking Rules**.
2. Toggle on **Allow Online Appointment Booking**.
3. Navigate to **Scheduling > Visit Types**, select a visit type, and check the box for **Available Online**.
4. Under **Settings > Schedule > Provider Availability**, designate which staff members accept online requests.

**Limits & Conditions:**
Patients can only book appointments between 24 hours and 60 days in advance. Urgent visit types cannot be made available online.

**Troubleshooting:**
If a provider does not appear for booking, verify their schedule template is published and that their assigned rooms are active under **Settings > Facility > Rooms**.

Ticket:
Fix online booking now

Fix our online appointment booking right now! Patients are booking slots I am not working and I have a full waiting room.

value.text:
{
  "draft": "Hi,

We understand you’re seeing appointments booked for times you’re not working, and a member of our support team is reviewing the issue.

In the meantime, you can verify a few settings that often cause this behavior:

- Confirm that your schedule template is published and that any rooms assigned to you are active (Settings > Facility > Rooms).
- Ensure you are not listed as available for online booking: go to Settings > Patient Portal > Booking Rules and review the "Allow Online Appointment Booking" setting, then check Settings > Schedule > Provider Availability to make sure you are not marked to accept online requests for the affected times.
- Review the visit types marked as "Available Online" (Scheduling > Visit Types) and uncheck any that should not be bookable online.

If you need further assistance, please let us know.

Thank you."
}
